sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 231868 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20; live search API agrees, read 2026-10-26)

values.note: $25 per site in 2026, and the same in recreation.gov's 2027 table. Two vehicles or one RV per site included; $10 for a third vehicle. Walk-up fees by cash, check or money order in the self-service fee tube.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/collegiate-peaks-campground ('$25 per site for overnight camping. Two vehicles or one RV per site is included in the camping fee. $10 fee for a third vehicle'; last updated February 3, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231868/rates (2026 and 2027 seasons: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 25), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Forest Service: 'May to September', opening and closing dates weather dependent. Dates are recreation.gov's 2026 fee seasons (first-come May 15-21, reservable May 22 - Sept 19).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/collegiate-peaks-campground ('Seasons of Use: May to September. Opening and closing dates are weather dependent') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231868/rates (2026 First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-15 to 05-21, Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 09-19), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231868 (notice 'No hookups available') + campsite catalog for 231868 (all 56 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup No, Sewer Hookup No), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 56 single-family sites on three loops (44 reservable, 12 first-come in the catalog; site 2 is the host's mid-May through September). Five pull-throughs, the rest back-in. The catalog gives no per-site lengths.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/collegiate-peaks-campground ('56 campsites arranged along three loops', 'Maximum RV length is 50 feet') + campsite catalog for 231868 (reservable flag, Driveway Entry: 5 pull-through) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231868 ('Site #2 is used by the host from mid-May through September'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Firewood sold at the host site. Water, trash or a host may not be available early and late in the season.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/collegiate-peaks-campground ('Restrooms: Vault toilet', 'Potable water is available at this site', 'Firewood is available for sale at the host site', 'Services such as water, trash or a host may not be available during early and late season'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov (or 877-444-6777) at least four days ahead for the 2026 peak season May 22 - Sept 19; the first week (May 15-21) is first-come. Sites 1 and 18-30 are always first-come walk-ups and must be occupied the night they are paid for; walk-ups are exempt from the 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday-weekend minimums. Usually full from Friday, sometimes Thursday.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231868 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4; 'Sites# 1, and 18-30 are first come-first served'; 'normally full starting on Friday, sometimes as early as Thursday') + /rates (2026 seasons) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/collegiate-peaks-campground ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance ... A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 50% off the site the pass holder occupies (concessionaire-run sites).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/collegiate-peaks-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-26

note: Heavily wooded campground along the Middle Fork of Cottonwood Creek, 11 mi west of Buena Vista on paved CR 306 toward Cottonwood Pass (Salida RD, Pike-San Isabel NF). Ptarmigan Lake and Denny Creek trailheads nearby; a commercial hot springs ~5 mi east. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 (2026, 2027), no hookups, 56 sites, reservable on recreation.gov. Changed max_rig_ft 99 -> 50 (FS 'Maximum RV length is 50 feet'; the catalog has no lengths). Added season 05-15 to 09-19 (FS 'May to September' + rec.gov fee seasons), reservable season 05-22 to 09-19, some sites always FCFS, 4-day cutoff, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums, 14-night limit, pull-throughs, vault toilets, water, senior/access 50%. Note: dropped '~99 ft' and field repeats; 'Chalk Creek' corrected to Cottonwood Creek. No PSICC alert affects CR 306 or the campground.
flags: Entry phone is empty. Forest Service page: Salida Ranger District 719-539-3591. recreation.gov gives (661) 702-1420 'for facility specific information' (the concessionaire's line; the FS page names no concessionaire, and campgrounds have no phone service).
Agency page for the website if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/collegiate-peaks-campground (website is the recreation.gov listing).
